description: Figure 7, located at the bottom of the plot pair, displays the accuracy of Llama3.3 on the PopQA dataset as a function of entity popularity, specifically with respect to the subject popularity metric (s_pop frequency). The x-axis, labeled “s_pop frequency (x10^4)”, spans from 1 to 19 in increments of 2, representing the popularity of subject entities scaled by 10,000. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy”, ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. Two distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line with upward-pointing triangle markers representing one metric (likely final accuracy), and a green solid line with downward-pointing triangle markers representing another (likely initial or baseline accuracy). The blue line starts at approximately 0.72 at s_pop frequency 1, rises to a peak near 0.98 at frequency 17, and ends at 1.0 at frequency 19. The green line begins at approximately 0.38 at frequency 1, fluctuates with local peaks and troughs (e.g., ~0.65 at frequency 5, ~0.45 at frequency 9, ~0.65 at frequency 11, ~0.5 at frequency 13, ~0.6 at frequency 15), then sharply increases to 1.0 at frequency 17 and remains at 1.0 at frequency 19. Error bars are present on both lines, indicating variability in the measurements.
